challenge.label: Human verification
challenge.verified: Challenge completed; the server will verify it on submission
challenge.unavailable: Verification could not load or failed. Retry and check your connection and browser settings.
challenge.privacy: Cloudflare provides verification and receives your browser IP address and security signals.

admin.title: CAPTCHA
admin.intro: Uses Cloudflare Turnstile. Create a widget in the Cloudflare dashboard, paste its site key and secret key here, then turn it on, complete one challenge below and save.
admin.enableHint: Sign-in, sign-up and password reset will ask for a challenge. The Lsky v1 API (PicGo and others) is not affected.
admin.configurationUnavailable: The server has no security.master_key, so the CAPTCHA secret cannot be saved. Contact the server administrator.
admin.stale: The configuration changed elsewhere. Reload before saving; your input is kept.
admin.hostnamesHint: Defaults to the host you are visiting; one per line, without scheme, port or path.
admin.verifyHint: The challenge loads with the site key above. After you complete it, save: the server checks it once with the secret key and turns protection on.
admin.privacy: Verification sends your browser IP, user agent and security and interaction signals to Cloudflare.
